title: Warp
tagline: Warp lets you Upload Files to IPFS & share it to a Mail Address which can only be accessed by the Receipent wallet Address which You choose to share.
description:
Warp is a secured file sharing Platform built on top of Web3.storage which lets users to Upload file to decentralised storage of IPFS, User has to put Wallet Address of the receipient which will be the only one who can access this file.
The download link for this files are then shared to the receiver's Mail ID.

The user data is stored to Tableland Database which lets the user to share data with the least cost possible.
how_its_made:
Warp makes use of @Tableland & @IPFS to securely store & share P2P data with the highest possible Size Limit.

User needs to not worry about the high cost of confidential file sharing as the links can only be accessed by authenticated Wallet - the one you chosed while sharing the Files.
